_about: Hand-curated correspondence between the numbered statements of PAPER_v2_narrative.md and the Lean declarations of the unified SurfaceBlowup codebase. build.py resolves every Lean name below against the sources (file, line range, docstring, statement, Prove2Me node) and writes data/paper_lean_map.json. Relations: exact = the Lean statement says the same thing (up to encoding); definition = the paper's construction is the Lean definition (and, where listed, the theorem that it means what the paper says); specialization = proved in a special setting (e.g. only on the concrete surfaces O[[T,X]]/(pi - u T^a X^b), or only for a = b = 1); covered = no single Lean statement, the listed declarations jointly establish the content, often in a restructured form; check = only particular instances are machine-checked; none = not formalized (declarations listed, if any, are ingredients only). Confidence is the curator's confidence in the correspondence, not in the mathematics.

entries.summary: The monic half, Pr(ramified) = 1/(q+1) over every complete DVR, is the Lean corollary monicDensity_two_ramified (from main_dvr). The cluster half, q/(q+1), is clusterDensity_two_ramified (v1.1, from main_dvr_cluster), with the split and inert values 1/(2(q+1)) each in clusterDensity_two_split / clusterDensity_two_inert.

entries.label: Type of degree n
entries.title: factorization types
entries.summary: A type is a multiset of pairs (e,f); its degree is Σ e·f. ValidType requires e, f ≥ 1.

entries.label: Monic model
entries.title: monic type probability
entries.summary: monicDensity O n σ is the normalized Haar measure of the coefficient vectors a ∈ Oⁿ for which X^n + Σ aᵢXⁱ is a product of distinct monic irreducibles over Frac O whose invariants form σ. The invariant (e,f) of a factor is read from the integral closure of O in its root field (factorInvariant). This is the trust boundary: the definitions are owner-signed.

entries.label: Projective model
entries.title: binary-form type probability
entries.summary: projectiveDensity O n σ is the conditional Haar measure of type σ among primitive vectors of O^{n+1}. A drop in degree contributes the point at infinity with type (1,1) (HasBinaryType). The paper's remark that unrestricted coefficients give the same law is not formalized.

entries.label: Type variables Z_{e,f}
entries.title: laws as polynomials in type variables
entries.summary: A law is a finite formal sum of types with rational-expression coefficients (Law); in the reciprocity part laws are read in Coef = ℚ(q)[Z_{e,f}] (lawCoef). Products of laws add types (lawMul).
lean: a law as an element of Coef

entries.summary: All three clauses. Monic and projective: main_dvr — for every complete DVR O with finite residue field (any characteristic, any ramification; adic topology, Borel σ-algebra, normalized Haar measure), monicDensity O n σ and projectiveDensity O n σ are the values at q = |k| of monicExpr n σ and projectiveExpr n σ, whose rational functions are A_σ and R_σ; regularity at every prime power is global_formula_regular, packaged with the ∃ A R form in main_field_form. Cluster (v1.1): main_dvr_cluster — clusterDensity O n σ, the normalized Haar probability on monic polynomials reducing to X^n (paper's μ_cluster) with the published type predicate, equals clusterExpr n σ = lawCoeff (rootLaw n) σ, the coefficient of σ in the law of S(1;n) (display (7.1)), for every n including n = 0; regularity is cluster_formula_regular; recip_cluster reads A_σ(q) = B_σ(1/q) in this notation. The type predicate is the reduced-algebra convention; the agreement with the étale convention off a Haar-null set is main_dvr_etale / clusterDensity_eq_etale (Remark 1.3). The hypotheses 0 < n, ValidType σ, typeDegree σ = n of main_dvr are unused (frozen statement). Non-vacuity in equal characteristic: main_dvr_powerSeries.

entries.title: complete laws A_n, R_n
entries.summary: The complete laws are the global laws globalLaw false n (A_n, monic) and globalLaw true n (R_n, projective), and rootLaw n = stateLaw S(1;n) (B_n, cluster); A_σ, B_σ, R_σ are their σ-coefficients.

entries.label: Cluster model and cluster law B_n
entries.title: the X^n model
entries.summary: The cluster model draws the nonleading coefficients from πO. Its law B_n is rootLaw n = stateLaw (S(1;n)); root_cell_law proves that this is the type law of X^n + π·(z_{n-1}X^{n-1} + … + z_0) with z uniform in Oⁿ (in the route-F type convention).

entries.summary: recip_main states, for n > 0 and every type σ, the identities of rational functions (monicExpr n σ).rational = (B_{n,σ} with q ↦ 1/q).rational, where B_{n,σ} = lawCoeff (rootLaw n) σ, and (projectiveExpr n σ) is invariant under q ↦ 1/q. These are the coefficientwise forms of A_n = B_n^∨ and R_n^∨ = R_n. The hypotheses ValidType σ and typeDegree σ = n are unused.

entries.summary: The remark's claims are the theorems it names: main_dvr (monic, projective), main_dvr_cluster (cluster, v1.1), recip_main (reciprocity); axioms of each are exactly propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound (Checks/Axioms.lean, 12 theorems). The convention claim — the reduced-algebra type (HasPolynomialType: distinct monic irreducible factors, inseparable factors allowed) and the étale convention agree off a Haar-null set — is monic_inseparable_null, binary_nonEtale_null, and the equalities monicDensity_eq_etale, projectiveDensity_eq_etale, clusterDensity_eq_etale, packaged as main_dvr_etale; etaleMonicDensity_eq_algebraType phrases the monic event as 'K[X]/(f_a) is étale (Algebra.Etale) and has algebra type σ'.

entries.label: Standard facts
entries.title: cited background
entries.summary: Cited in the paper, proved in the Lean development from Mathlib (no literature axioms): integral closures in finite extensions are finite free of rank [L:K] when finite and are complete DVRs; unramified extensions O_δ = O[X]/(Φ) are complete DVRs with a Frobenius whose fixed ring is O. Analytic inversion / change of variables is not used: the Lean proof replaces it by finite-digit congruence arguments.

entries.label: Reduced-algebra type convention
entries.title: types of reduced algebras
entries.summary: HasAlgebraType O B σ: the generic fibre of B is a finite product of fields whose O-integral closures are finite, with invariants σ. The Lean development uses this route-F convention (finite integral closures) everywhere in the recursion, and transfers to the published étale densities through the Haar-null bridges.

entries.summary: Single-boundary case: F_{S(a;1)} = Z_{a,1} is part of the definition of stateLaw (terminal_law), and its meaning is proved on the concrete surfaces (the curve order is a DVR with field invariant (a,1): terminal_curve_order_dvr, terminal_field_invariant, concrete_member_terminal_type). Crossing cases: in Lean only S(a;1) is terminal; the laws of T(a,b;1,h) and T(a,b;c,1) are computed from the recursion in the private regression lemmas crossing_left_one_law / crossing_right_one_law (for rational q > 1), matching Z_{a+bh,1} and Z_{ac+b,1}.

entries.label: Allowed residue ideals, cells, occupied points
entries.title: geometric terms
entries.summary: Residue ideals of the special fibre with prescribed contacts (singleResidueIdeals, crossingResidueIdeals); a cell is the set of ideals with fixed order d and tangent divisor (HasTangentDivisor); tangent patterns record the combinatorics of a divisor (TangentPattern, Allowed).

entries.label: Contact-size order
entries.title: induction order on states
entries.summary: Lean uses a different well-founded measure, State.rank = 2N² + 2(N − w) + tag, and proves that every non-self child has strictly smaller rank (nonself_child_rank_lt); this plays the role of the paper's contact-size order in every induction.

The division maps (3.1) are division_linear_equivalence (from a lifted basis of R/(f)) and the unique factorization (3.2) is unique_scaled_generator_normalization: every f + πh is uniquely (1 + πu)(f + π Σ zᵢbᵢ). The analytic-dependence part (3.3)–(3.4) is not formalized; the formal proof uses instead that the normalization preserves π-adic congruences (normalizer_preserves_adic_congruence, coordinate_transition_congruence).

The chart (3.5) is a bijection onto its residue-ideal cell (coordinate_ideal_cell_bijection); chart transitions preserve Haar measure (ideal_chart_transition_haar, the formal counterpart of 'unit Jacobian'), so the pushed-forward chart measures and the state measure of an atlas are independent of choices (ideal_chart_pushforward_independent, state_measure_atlas_independent). The tangent-lattice statement is not formalized.

State volumes q^{-c} and (q−1)q^{-c-h} are proved for any ideal atlas indexed by the residue ideals (single_state_volume, crossing_state_volume), from the residue-ideal counts q^{ac−c} and (q−1)q^{ac+bh−c−h}; the concrete surfaces admit such atlases (concrete_single/crossing_state_volume). The volumes appear in the recursion as the definition stateVolume.

entries.title: layers of the exceptional thickenings
entries.summary: The Lean development has no formal scheme; it works with the two blow-up charts R[x/t], R[t/x] and their exceptional filtrations. The layers I^j/I^{j+1} are identified with polynomial modules on a chart and Laurent-polynomial modules on the overlap, which is the content of 𝓘^j/𝓘^{j+1} ≅ 𝒪_E(j).

Formalized only in a restructured, sheaf-free form: finite two-chart Čech complexes at each exceptional level, surjective reductions (actual_cech_reductions_surjective), stabilization of the twisted cokernels (actual_twisted_coker_reduction_bijective), and the identification of R with compatible closed threads (surface_threads_range). There is no formal completion 𝔛 and no sheaf cohomology in the Lean development.
lean: H⁰ of the limit = compatible threads

entries.summary: H⁰ = R: surface_threads_injective / surface_threads_range (complete R maps isomorphically onto compatible closed threads), glued_function_exists_unique (glued generators come from a unique function of order d). length H¹(𝒪(dE)) = C(d,2): actual_finite_cech_coefficient_triangular (length of the stable twisted Čech cokernel). The triviality of degree-zero line bundles is not formalized; the formal proof glues generators directly instead.

entries.title: tangent divisor and child contacts
entries.summary: The tangent divisor of the initial form (initial_form_has_tangent_divisor, homogeneous_divisor_boundary_multiplicities: a boundary point is occupied iff the corresponding extreme coefficient vanishes), the exceptional contact r_P of a strict transform (concrete_strict_transform_multiplicity), and the old-boundary contact c − d (concrete_infinity_boundary_contact, concrete_zero_boundary_contact).

entries.title: children of S and T
entries.summary: The child tables are the definition children (with the admissibility predicate Allowed: r_t > 0 ⇔ d < c, r_x > 0 ⇔ d < h); strict_transform_mapsTo_child_ideals proves that strict transforms of a fixed-tangent cell land in exactly these child states.

entries.summary: On the concrete surfaces: strict transform is injective on a fixed-tangent cell and a bijection onto the product of the child ideal sets (strict_transform_injOn_fixed_tangent_cell, strict_transform_bijOn_child_ideals); the index map A_f → B_f is injective with cokernel of O-length C(d,2) (concrete_curve_order_index, child_order_index_and_kernel, cell_member_index_map). The identification of the cokernel with H¹(𝔛, 𝒪(dE)) is replaced by the Čech computation.

member_cell_box_measure: for a cell of a concrete recursion member and measurable child sets G_j, μ(cell ∩ ST⁻¹(∏ G_j)) = q^{-tri d} ∏ μ_j(G_j), where tri d = C(d+1,2). Boxes generate the product σ-algebra, so this is (5.1). The Jacobian computation (5.3) appears as the cokernel length s·N − tri d of the strict normalizer (strict_quotient_cokernel_length, member_center_linear_part); the inverse-function-theorem step is replaced by finite-digit measure arguments (strict_chart_one_ball_measure). Haar measure on O_δ is the product measure in the power basis (unramified_coefficient_measure_pi).

entries.summary: Worked example; not formalized as such. Its conclusion (transition probability q^{-3}) is an instance of divisorProbability and child_volume_ratio.

The probabilities (6.1) are the definition divisorProbability; child_volume_ratio proves the paper's computation (q^{-tri d} × product of child volumes ÷ parent volume = divisorProbability), and member_cell_box_measure gives conditional independence of the children. entries.title: exit contribution Γ_{a;c}
entries.summary: exitLaw s is the sum over allowed tangent patterns except the self pattern; S(a;c) (c ≥ 2) has exactly one self pattern, of total count q (self_patterns_of_single_state, exists_unique_selfPattern_single), and its weight q·q^{-tri c} is returnWeight c.

entries.title: the crossing formula
entries.summary: The crossing branch of stateLawFuel (the law of T(a,b;c,h) is its exit law; state_law_unfold).

(i) stateLaw s is defined by the finite recursion and is safe at every q ≥ 2 (local_law_safe; regularity at prime powers of the global formula: global_formula_regular). (ii)–(iii) universal_law_statement: for every member i of every surface universe, the type events are measurable, μ(type σ) = F_s[σ](q) · μ(state), and the nonterminating set is null — the same stateLaw for all members, which is the universality. A concrete universe (all concrete surfaces, closed under children) exists (concrete_universe_exists). (iv) state_law_unfold is (6.8). Specialization: the members are the concrete surfaces rather than all surfaces realizing the state; homogeneity of weight N is not stated separately.
lean: (ii)–(iii) for every member of every surface universe

entries.summary: The formal proof handles inseparability differently: the recursion uses types with finite integral closures (route F, which does allow inseparable terminal fields), and the published étale densities are recovered because the inseparable locus of monic polynomials is Haar-null (monic_inseparable_null, orig_monicDensity_eq, orig_projectiveDensity_eq). The itinerary argument of the remark is not formalized.

entries.label: Proof of Theorem 6.2
entries.title: induction, geometric series, termination
entries.summary: Strong induction on State.rank (universal_law_statement) through the crossing step (recursion_crossing_law) and the single-boundary step (recursion_single_law), which sums the returns: k returns then exit have mass λ^k Γ (exit_event_succ_mass, return_event_mass), never exiting is null (never_return_null), and the series is summed by geometric_exit_sum. Termination outside null events: nonterminating_subset_return_or_bad, bad_exit_null.

(6.10) is the private regression lemma single_two_law, proved from the definitions for every vertical multiplicity a and every rational q > 1 (law of S(a;2): q/(q+1) Z_{2a,1} + (Z_{a,1}² + Z_{a,2})/(2(q+1))).

The second identity R_{(n,1)}^∨ = R_{(n,1)} is recip_main (second clause) at σ = {(n,1)}. The first identity needs (10.1), which is not formalized.
